blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The 43rd day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s Senate impeachment trial ended with the defense having dropped all of its originally scheduled bank witnesses and the court adjourning until after the ASEAN Summit. Presiding officer Sen. Francis Escudero granted lead defense counsel Sheila Sison’s request to cancel Friday’s session, with Sison noting the defense has “around eight to 10 witnesses” remaining in the trial.
